create_render_layer: create a RenderLayer instance with height, width, face indices, UV coordinates, and UV triangle indices for mesh rasterization
render_meshes_forward: render 3D meshes with UV textures by passing vertices, texture maps, camera intrinsics K, and extrinsics Rt to RenderLayer forward
rasterize_with_pytorch3d: rasterize PyTorch3D Meshes using a MeshRasterizer with RasterizationSettings to produce fragment outputs from vertices and faces
sample_uv_textures: sample UV texture maps onto rasterized mesh fragments using TexturesUV with face UVs and vertex UVs for photorealistic rendering
review_render_layer: review the RenderLayer class and its forward method to understand mesh rasterization, UV texture sampling, and camera projection logic
